integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and stand-alone symbolic/finite checker are included. Finite diagnostics are not proofs of infinite limits; no external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp law proved only for the equal-rate two-threshold slice with 0<b<=1/3 and initially infected simplex states; neighboring parameter regimes and full SISI conjecture not settled. Indexed originality checks do not eliminate possible unindexed coverage.
title: Global critical extinction and separate infection-stage power laws in a discrete SISI model
